titulo: Forgot why I came up: stop, say what for, one step down
caption:
Forgot why I came up: stop, say what for, one step down

I forgot why I came up. If I forget why I came, I stop and say what for: a slow in, a rest on the landing, one step down. Wrong room. For whoever stands in doorways like this.

Closer to yourself.

More behaviors: link in bio.

alt: A short film on a flat-color background in a escaleras: a small doorway-shaped figure beside escalera-rellano. The caption "I forgot why I came up." appears with, beneath it in italics, "I was moving without knowing where." Then the rule: "If I forget why I came," with an arrow down to "I stop and say what for." A line rises and falls over the figure's head as it breathes: In, Landing, Step. The question "When do I forget why I came up?" and then a card with the sentence "I forget why I came up when ______." and a blank line to fill in. The last words: "Closer to your stairs." and "Closer to yourself."
